label: D1 after an unrewarded trial, policy leaning a1
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (92% of mass; never at D2, little at GO) when the reward input is 0 (previous trial unrewarded: 91% mass). Within that, it is selective for the agent favouring a1: the upcoming action is a1 (83% of mass) and the policy logit(a1)-logit(a2) is moderately positive (2.8..8; 78% of mass), so the predicate uses the model own choice logit rather than the future action (action==1 gives similar F1 0.62). Magnitude grows with episode time (trials 90-99 hold 41% of mass) and with low value-head output (value < 5.2 bin holds 42% of mass); it is silent at the highest values and for strongly a2-leaning policy. Phase+no-reward alone: mass recall 0.91 but precision 0.33. Residual activity: weak GO activations during long a1 runs, and many unrewarded a1-leaning D1 steps early in the episode stay inactive.
